title: Module 03 Quiz: Relations & Integration Architecture
description: Test your knowledge of Juju relations, endpoints, relation databags, and lifecycle events.

questions.prompt: What is the primary benefit of relations in Juju over manual configuration?
options: Dynamic automated discovery and real-time exchange of credentials and connection data
Automatic code recompilation of the Linux kernel
Merging multiple containers into a single virtual machine
questions.answer: Dynamic automated discovery and real-time exchange of credentials and connection data
questions.explanation: Relations automate connection discovery, credentials sharing, and dynamic re-configuration.

questions.prompt: Which endpoint role allows units of the same application to communicate for clustering or leader election?
questions.explanation: Peer relations allow units of the same charm to form quorums, share state, and elect leaders.

questions.prompt: Which CLI command connects two applications via compatible relation endpoints?
questions.explanation: 'juju integrate' (and its alias 'juju relate') connects two applications.

questions.prompt: What must two charms have in common in order to be integrated?
options: Compatible interface protocols on their endpoints
The exact same number of deployed units
questions.answer: Compatible interface protocols on their endpoints
questions.explanation: Endpoints must declare matching interfaces (e.g., http, pgsql, ingress) to relate.

questions.prompt: Which command removes an existing relation between 'web' and 'database'?
Which relation lifecycle event is fired when a new unit joins an existing relation?
questions.explanation: 'relation-joined' fires when a specific unit enters the relation.

questions.prompt: Which relation event is triggered when remote participating units update keys in their databags?
questions.explanation: 'relation-changed' informs units that relation data has been added or updated.

questions.prompt: What is the scope of an 'Application databag' in a relation?
options: Shared across all units of that application in the relation
Scoped strictly to a single individual unit
Shared across all controllers in the cloud
Scoped only to the Juju client CLI
questions.answer: Shared across all units of that application in the relation
questions.explanation: Application databags hold application-wide configuration and credentials shared by all units.

questions.prompt: Which command displays a table of all active relations in the current model?
questions.explanation: 'juju relations' lists all active relations in the active model.

questions.prompt: Which event fires on participating charms when a relation is completely severed?
questions.explanation: 'relation-broken' signals the total destruction of the relation between the services.
